title: Give the provider-level currency tests a moment that is unambiguous for every claim they assert over
objective: tests/integration/test_catalogue_currency.py::_free_offer returns the FIRST match while walking provider.services -> svc.offers, and NEITHER relationship declares order_by, so the anchor is whatever order the database happens to return. That anchor's own expiry boundary is then used by tests whose assertions range over a PROVIDER-LEVEL or CATEGORY-CELL-LEVEL rollup. When the anchor is not the offer holding the provider's earliest expiry, a sibling claim is already past its own window at that moment and an exact-equality assertion flips. Test-only defect; the remedy is the moment, not the ordering.

the_remedy_and_why_it_follows_the_siblin.sibling_principle: test_provider_detail_rollup_reports_its_stalest_claim's docstring: 'The boundary belongs to a single anchor; a rollup needs a moment that is unambiguous for all of them.'
the_remedy_and_why_it_follows_the_siblin.sibling_literal_move: It retreated from the boundary to the fetch moment.
the_remedy_and_why_it_follows_the_siblin.why_the_literal_move_is_NOT_available_he: Applied to test_zero_freshness_is_a_measurement_and_null_freshness_is_not it would DELETE the test's subject. That test exists to prove that 0.0 and null are different answers AT THE EXACT EXPIRY BOUNDARY; freshness at the fetch moment is 1.0, so the assertion it was written to make would no longer be made. The same objection applies to the permit arm of test_the_free_offer_count_..., which needs the last still-current moment, and to test_providers_list_freshness_follows_the_clock, whose boundary read is its point. The module docstring calls this one-second differential 'the impossible-value floor these instruments need in order to be able to fail'; retreating from it would lower that floor.
the_remedy_and_why_it_follows_the_siblin.chosen: Keep the boundary; change WHOSE boundary it is. A new provider_boundary fixture derives the moment from the PROVIDER's own earliest-expiring published claim -- min over every published version of (oldest evidence fetched_at + that source's window) -- instead of from one arbitrarily-chosen offer.
the_remedy_and_why_it_follows_the_siblin.why_this_IS_the_sibling_principle: It is the same sentence, applied faithfully rather than literally: a rollup gets a moment unambiguous for all of them. At M = min expiry, no claim is stale (M <= every expiry, and staleness is strict '>'), so every claim is current and the worst freshness is exactly 0.0. At M + 1s the earliest-expiring claim is stale. The sibling could satisfy the sentence by stepping off the boundary because it did not need the boundary; these three do, so the sentence has to be satisfied at the boundary instead.
the_remedy_and_why_it_follows_the_siblin.why_NOT_a_deterministic_anchor: Pinning _free_offer to a stable order would make the tests pass reproducibly while leaving them still reading a multi-offer rollup at a single-offer boundary. It would be re-armed by the first corpus change that adds an offer with an earlier snapshot, and it would fail the invariance proof: the tests would be PINNED, not INVARIANT. The proof demanded is that the anchor choice no longer changes the outcome.
the_remedy_and_why_it_follows_the_siblin.heterogeneous_windows: Using min(fetched_at + window) rather than min(fetched_at) + window is deliberate: it is correct even when two sources declare different schedules, where min(fetched_at) + window is not.
the_remedy_and_why_it_follows_the_siblin.asserted_precondition_not_announced: The +1s stale arm is only unambiguous for ALL claims if every published claim expires within that same second. That assumption is now CHECKED in the fixture (spread of expiries < 1 second) rather than left implicit, so a future corpus that spread wider would fail loudly with a named reason instead of flipping intermittently.

verification_method.baseline_rule: A baseline must be shown to have EXECUTED at least one test, not merely to have exited 0. The runner parses `collected N` (falling back to summing outcome counts under -q) and ABORTS when N is below an explicitly-passed floor; pytest exit 5 is treated as NOTHING COLLECTED and aborts separately.
verification_method.mutation_rule: The anchor mutation must be shown to have APPLIED: exact search text present exactly once before, absent after, replacement present once, and `git diff --numstat` non-empty. Restoration is verified by comparing `git hash-object` against `git rev-parse HEAD:<path>`, so the harness cannot leave the thing it measured mutated.
verification_method.environment_rule: Preconditions asserted, not announced: pg_isready with a checked exit code, then the database confirmed present in pg_database, then a trivial query confirmed to EXECUTE and return the expected value. A CREATE DATABASE that prints 'ready' without a checked exit code produced a false KILL on this project before, and a false KILL confirms whatever you hoped. Wall runtime is reported on every run because a large deviation from baseline is evidence about the ENVIRONMENT, not the code.
verification_method.skip_is_not_a_pass: Without DATABASE_URL the module reports 22 skipped and 0 passed. Measured, so that a skipped integration run can never be mistaken for a green one.
verification_method.powershell_trap: Select-Object -First/-Last corrupts $LASTEXITCODE. Exit codes are read from BARE calls only.
verification_method.apparatus_isolation: The mutation harness and the code under test necessarily share the test file, because the anchor IS the thing being mutated. What is kept separate is the DATABASE: a dedicated instance on an unused port, seeded independently of the suite's, so no measurement is served from state another measurement is writing.
verification_method.database: Own postgres:16-alpine, container 'fta-anchor-slice-pg', named volume 'fta-anchor-slice-pgdata', port 55437 (asserted free before use), database 'ftaanchor'. REMOVED at end of session -- container AND volume -- using EXACT-NAME anchored filters, because Docker's default name filter is a SUBSTRING match. The exact names removed and the residual-check output are reported.
